title: InputSpec
description: One declared, typed input of a node (docs/design/m0/13 "Model"). The node runs only once each input resolves to a selected, reusable, applicable result (06); until then it waits on that input structurally (13 "Evaluation"). A model node's controller-supplied context is rendered only from its resolved inputs (13 [G7]), so information that no input declares cannot reach it.

name.description: The input's name within its node; internal/graph refuses a duplicate name.

source.description: Where the input's value comes from, discriminated by type.

ResultSource.description: The selected result of a producer node in the same graph, of exactly the declared kind.

AnswerSource.description: The answer to an owed input: an input.answer approval that binds exactly this revision (04 "Owed inputs"). Only a successor review declares it, never the review that asked (13 "Successor rounds"). It resolves to the approval's id and this revision, which is what the computation key hashes for it. A receipt owed input is declared as a result of its evidence node instead, since a ruling never satisfies it; the resolver (G4a) refuses an answer source whose owed input has kind receipt.
